title: Northgate Protect Service Fee Bands
content:
A service fee may be owed on an approved Northgate Protect claim. Each tier sets its fee by the covered item's price band, where the price is the net price paid for the item before tax, and names the claim types on which the fee is charged.

## Fee bands

| Tier | Item price band | Service fee per approved claim |
|---|---|---|
| Standard 2-Year | $0.00 to $5000.00 | $0.00 |
| Standard 3-Year | $0.00 to $5000.00 | $0.00 |
| Accident 2-Year | $0.00 to $499.99 | $0.00 |
| Accident 2-Year | $500.00 to $999.99 | $29.00 |
| Accident 2-Year | $1,000.00 to $5000.00 | $49.00 |
| Accident 3-Year | $0.00 to $499.99 | $0.00 |
| Accident 3-Year | $500.00 to $999.99 | $29.00 |
| Accident 3-Year | $1,000.00 to $5000.00 | $49.00 |
| Accident 4-Year | $0.00 to $499.99 | $0.00 |
| Accident 4-Year | $500.00 to $999.99 | $29.00 |
| Accident 4-Year | $1,000.00 to $5000.00 | $49.00 |
| Complete Monthly | $0.00 to $499.99 | $49.00 |
| Complete Monthly | $500.00 to $2500.00 | $99.00 |

## Claim types on which the fee is charged

| Tier | Claim types charged |
|---|---|
| Standard 2-Year and Standard 3-Year | Mechanical failure |
| Accident 2-Year, Accident 3-Year and Accident 4-Year | Accidental damage |
| Complete Monthly | Mechanical failure, accidental damage, battery failure |

## Reading the bands

- Both ends of a band belong to it: on an Accident tier an item at exactly $500.00 is in the $29.00 band and an item at $499.99 in the $0.00 band.
- *Hypothetical:* on Northgate Protect Complete Monthly, an item with a net price of $640.00 sits in the $500.00 to $2500.00 band, $99.00, on a claim type the tier charges.
